title: Zero SDR Keyboard
summary: Tune RTL-SDR with a native spectrum, waterfall, and direct Cardputer keyboard entry.
description: A native, keyboard-first SDR receiver for Cardputer Zero's 320×170 display. Connect a supported RTL-SDR dongle to tune 22.0–948.6 MHz, inspect a live spectrum and waterfall, and listen to local WFM audio. Direct MHz entry, tuner-reported gain steps, reconnect guidance, dark/light themes, persistent settings, and ten UI languages are built in. A deterministic offline demo works without a dongle. All processing stays on-device; Zero SDR needs no network or cloud service.
